function:chvalid.h:xmlIsBaseChar.scope: Deprecated upstream function implemented as a pure SPARK scalar classifier for the pinned historical BaseChar set: 197 short ranges plus five ranges below U+0100, mechanically matching chvalid.h and codegen/ranges.inc. U+4E00 is not included. All other values, including high unsigned values, return 0. This legacy set is not a modern Unicode category and does not change current NCName rules (U+037F and a followed by U+0346 remain accepted). No pointer or native range-table access, allocation, diagnostics, lock, or DOM access. Only the function is implemented; macros, range-group APIs, and DTD support are not. C ABI and complete upstream semantics are not proved.

function:chvalid.h:xmlIsBlank.scope: Deprecated upstream function exposed as a pure SPARK scalar classifier. Returns exactly 1 for U+0009, U+000A, U+000D and U+0020, otherwise 0, including unsigned values above Natural'Last. No allocation, diagnostics, lock, or DOM access. This entry covers only function symbols, not header macros or range-group APIs; C ABI and complete upstream semantics are not proved.

function:chvalid.h:xmlIsCombining.scope: Deprecated upstream function implemented as a pure SPARK scalar classifier for the pinned historical Combining set of 95 short ranges, mechanically matching chvalid.h and codegen/ranges.inc. U+0346 is excluded even though current NCName validation accepts it after a base character. All other values, including high unsigned values, return 0. This legacy set is not a modern Unicode category and does not change current name rules. No pointer or native range-table access, allocation, diagnostics, lock, or DOM access. Only the function is implemented; macros, range-group APIs, and DTD support are not. C ABI and complete upstream semantics are not proved.

function:chvalid.h:xmlIsChar.scope: Deprecated upstream function exposed as a pure SPARK scalar classifier. Returns exactly 1 for XML 1.0 Char ranges U+0009/U+000A/U+000D, U+0020-U+D7FF, U+E000-U+FFFD and U+10000-U+10FFFF; otherwise 0. No extra noncharacter filtering is applied within the supplementary range; high unsigned values return false before narrowing. No allocation, diagnostics, lock, or DOM access. This entry covers only function symbols, not header macros or range-group APIs; C ABI and complete upstream semantics are not proved.

function:chvalid.h:xmlIsDigit.scope: Deprecated upstream function implemented as a pure SPARK scalar classifier for the fixed historical ranges U+0030-U+0039, U+0660-U+0669, U+06F0-U+06F9, U+0966-U+096F, U+09E6-U+09EF, U+0A66-U+0A6F, U+0AE6-U+0AEF, U+0B66-U+0B6F, U+0BE7-U+0BEF, U+0C66-U+0C6F, U+0CE6-U+0CEF, U+0D66-U+0D6F, U+0E50-U+0E59, U+0ED0-U+0ED9 and U+0F20-U+0F29; all other values, including high unsigned values, return 0. This legacy set is not a modern Unicode category and does not affect current NCName rules (U+0BE6 remains accepted). No pointer access, allocation, diagnostics, lock, or DOM access. Only the function is implemented; macros, range-group APIs, and DTD support are not.

function:chvalid.h:xmlIsExtender.scope: Deprecated upstream function implemented as a pure SPARK scalar classifier for exactly U+00B7, U+02D0-U+02D1, U+0387, U+0640, U+0E46, U+0EC6, U+3005, U+3031-U+3035, U+309D-U+309E and U+30FC-U+30FE; all other values, including high unsigned values, return 0. This fixed historical set is not a modern Unicode category and does not alter current name rules. No pointer access, allocation, diagnostics, lock, or DOM access. Only the function is implemented; macros, range-group APIs, and DTD support are not.

function:chvalid.h:xmlIsIdeographic.scope: Deprecated upstream function implemented as a pure SPARK scalar classifier for exactly U+3007, U+3021-U+3029 and U+4E00-U+9FA5; all other values, including high unsigned values, return 0. This fixed historical set is not a modern Unicode category and does not alter current name rules (U+9FA6 remains accepted). No pointer access, allocation, diagnostics, lock, or DOM access. Only the function is implemented; macros, range-group APIs, and DTD support are not.

function:chvalid.h:xmlIsPubidChar.scope: Deprecated upstream function implemented as a pure SPARK scalar classifier for the XML PubidChar ASCII set: SPACE, LF, CR, ASCII alphanumeric and -'()+,./:=?;!*#@$_%; TAB and all other values are excluded, including high unsigned values. This is only a character predicate, not a DTD subsystem. No pointer access, allocation, diagnostics, lock, or DOM access. Only the function is implemented; macros and range-group APIs are not. C ABI and complete upstream semantics are not proved.

function:entities.h:xmlEncodeSpecialChar.scope: SPARK-backed XML special-character escaping of valid UTF-8/XML text. Escapes less/greater-than, ampersand, double quote and CR; preserves apostrophe/LF/TAB and valid non-ASCII. NULL input returns NULL; empty input allocates an empty copy; document is unused. Rejects invalid UTF-8/XML characters instead of reference replacement/preservation, checks expansion limits, and preserves input on allocation failure. Native pointer/ABI/allocator/byte writes and complete public semantics remain unproved; no DTD/entity subsystem is provided.

function:entities.h:xmlEncodeEntitiesRee.scope: SPARK-backed bounded XML escaping through the shared Escape_Special helper. NULL input returns NULL before document validation; otherwise doc must be NULL or a registered Document_Node. Empty input returns an independently allocated empty string. Less-than, greater-than and ampersand use named references; CR becomes ; valid non-ASCII uses uppercase hexadecimal character references; quotes, TAB and LF remain literal. The subset does not retain document encoding, so explicit UTF-8 documents can differ from reference output. Invalid UTF-8/XML is rejected rather than repaired or preserved. Existing/general entity expansion and HTML behavior are unsupported. Output is independent and allocation failure returns NULL without DOM mutation. Native pointer/readability, byte access, allocation/copy/free, ABI and complete public semantics remain trusted.

function:parser.h:xmlInitParser.scope: 現在のUTF-8/UTF-16・読み取り専用DOMサブセット内。全オプション・全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:parser.h:xmlCleanupParser.scope: 現在のUTF-8/UTF-16・読み取り専用DOMサブセット内。全オプション・全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:parser.h:xmlReadMemory.scope: 現在のUTF-8/UTF-16・読み取り専用DOMサブセット内。全オプション・全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:parser.h:xmlParseMemory.scope: 現在のUTF-8/UTF-16・読み取り専用DOMサブセット内。全オプション・全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:parser.h:xmlReadDoc.scope: NUL終端UTF-8入力の読み取り専用DOMサブセット内。strlenを使うためbinary UTF-16入力には使用できない。全オプション・全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:parser.h:xmlParseDoc.scope: NUL終端UTF-8入力の読み取り専用DOMサブセット内。strlenを使うためbinary UTF-16入力には使用できない。全オプション・全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:tree.h:xmlDocGetRootElement.scope: 現在のUTF-8/UTF-16・読み取り専用DOMサブセット内。全オプション・全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:tree.h:xmlNewDoc.scope: version NULL 時は1.0、指定 C string はそのままコピー。XML 1.0 制限は parser に適用。DOMの所有権・寿命判断はSPARK Store/Runtime、native pointer・ABI・allocatorは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlDocDumpMemoryEnc.scope: 明示UTF-8（ASCII case-insensitive、宣言では入力表記を保持）とNULL encoding、XML 1.0のみ。NULLはencoding宣言を省きtext/属性/namespace URIの非ASCIIを大文字16進文字参照へ変換し、名前/comment/PI/CDATAはUTF-8保持。空encoding名は拒否。source encoding/standalone metadataは保持せず元encodingへ復帰しない。全DOMを不変状態からSPARKで検査・二段階出力し、成功バッファはxmlFree所有。invalid XML/name/namespaceはfail-closed。このAPIは整形なし。DTD/I/O未対応、native pointer/ABI/allocatorは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlDocDumpMemory.scope: xmlDocDumpMemoryEncのNULL encoding経路を共有するXML 1.0メモリ出力。encoding宣言なし、text/属性/namespace URIの非ASCIIを文字参照にし、名前/comment/PI/CDATAはUTF-8保持。source encoding/standalone metadataは保持せず元encodingを復元しない。成功バッファは独立したxmlFree所有、失敗はNULL/長さ0でDOM不変。検査と出力はSPARK、C境界は変換とdispatchのみ。このAPIは整形なし。DTD/I/O未対応、native pointer/ABI/allocatorは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlDocDumpFormatMemory.scope: 既定encodingのXML 1.0メモリ出力。format=0は通常出力、非0は固定版の既定2空白・最大60空白の字下げ。Text/CDATAを直接持つ要素subtreeは整形せず兄弟で再開。DOMは不変、成功結果はxmlFree所有、失敗NULL/長さ0。encoding/standalone metadata復元・global字下げ設定・DTD/I/O未対応。走査/整形/確保はSPARK、native pointer/ABI/allocatorは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlDocDumpFormatMemoryEn.scope: 明示UTF-8またはNULL/既定encodingのXML 1.0整形メモリ出力。format=0は通常出力、非0は既定2空白・最大60空白。Text/CDATAを直接持つ要素subtreeの整形を抑制し兄弟で再開。元DOM不変、失敗NULL/長さ0、成功結果xmlFree所有。encoding/standalone metadata復元・global字下げ設定・DTD/I/O未対応。走査/整形/確保はSPARK、native pointer/ABI/allocatorは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlNodeAddContent.scope: 要素・属性は末尾Textを再利用し、なければText childを追加。Text/CDATA/comment/PIはraw UTF-8を連結し、entity展開はしない。NULL/emptyはno-op、文書等の他のlive kindもno-op。invalid facadeは拒否。DOMの所有権・寿命判断はSPARK Store/Runtime、native pointer・ABI・allocatorは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlNodeSetContent.scope: SPARK-owned replacement of scalar, element, and attribute content; element/attribute values decode predefined and numeric references. Malformed or unknown references and invalid UTF-8/XML characters are rejected before mutation only for element/attribute inputs; scalar Text/CDATA/Comment/PI content remains raw, with validation deferred to serialization. Literal CR/LF/TAB are preserved; DTD/entity nodes are unsupported.

function:tree.h:xmlNewChild.scope: SPARK-owned element construction and append to element/document parents, inheriting the parent namespace when ns is NULL. Predefined/numeric references are decoded with literal whitespace preserved; malformed/unknown references and invalid XML/UTF-8 content are rejected before construction. NULL/empty content creates no text child. Unpublished nodes are retired on failure. Fragment/HTML/DTD/general entity support and namespace repair are excluded; names remain raw until serialization validation.

function:tree.h:xmlNewDocText.scope: SPARK-owned raw text construction and document affiliation without attachment. NULL doc is supported; non-NULL doc must be a registered live document. Document owner retention keeps detached text safe after document release. Unpublished text is released if affiliation fails. Native pointers and complete API semantics remain outside the formal claim.

function:tree.h:xmlNewDocTextLen.scope: Length-bounded raw text construction with the same SPARK document affiliation and retention as xmlNewDocText. Input length/NULL semantics match xmlNewTextLen, retaining only the visible prefix before NUL. Native pointer validity remains trusted.

function:tree.h:xmlStringGetNodeList.scope: Deprecated public API in pinned libxml2 2.15.4. SPARK Store/Runtime decodes valid UTF-8/XML and predefined/numeric references into one detached text node, preserving literal CR/LF/TAB. NULL/empty input returns NULL; malformed input and unknown/general entities fail atomically; no entity-reference nodes are created. Optional document must be NULL or a registered live document and is retained by the text owner pin. Native pointers/bytes, allocation/copy, ABI, and complete C semantics remain trusted.

function:tree.h:xmlStringLenGetNodeList.scope: Deprecated public API in pinned libxml2 2.15.4. Shares xmlStringGetNodeList decoding and document ownership. Negative length is NUL-terminated; positive length stops at NUL or the bound. Zero length reads no input and returns NULL rather than reproducing the reference's unsafe first-byte read/empty-node result. Malformed input and unknown/general entities fail atomically; native pointer/byte validity, allocation/copy, ABI, and complete C semantics remain trusted.

function:tree.h:xmlNewTextLen.scope: Bounded raw text construction delegates to the existing SPARK constructor. Non-NULL input with negative length fails; zero length never reads input and creates empty non-NULL content. NULL content produces a NULL-content node regardless of length. Positive lengths stop at NUL or len bytes; hidden bytes after NUL are not retained. Native pointer validity remains trusted.

function:tree.h:xmlNodeAddContentLen.scope: Bounded raw-text append through SPARK Store/Runtime. Nonpositive length or NULL content is a no-op; positive length stops at NUL or len bytes. SPARK handles empty-text materialization when a positive-length input starts with NUL, text coalescing and failure rollback. Invisible bytes after NUL are not retained. Raw UTF-8 chunks can be appended and are validated at serialization.

function:tree.h:xmlNodeSetContentLen.scope: Length-bounded C string conversion delegates to the existing SPARK content replacement. Nonnegative lengths read at most len bytes and stop at NUL; zero length never reads content, negative lengths use NUL termination. Scalar bytes hidden after NUL are not retained. Element/attribute reference decoding, scalar raw text, namespace lifetime and failure rollback follow xmlNodeSetContent; unsupported general entities remain rejected.

function:tree.h:xmlNewTextChild.scope: SPARK-owned raw-text child construction for element/document parents, with explicit or inherited namespace. References are not decoded. NULL content creates no text child; empty content creates an empty text child. Raw bytes are retained like xmlNewText, with XML/UTF-8 validation and escaping at serialization. Unpublished nodes are retired on failure. Fragment/HTML/DTD support and namespace repair remain excluded.

function:tree.h:xmlNewNode.scope: 要素 node と library-owned namespace borrowing。raw name string をコピーし XML name/UTF-8 検証なし。DOMの所有権・寿命判断はSPARK Store/Runtime、native pointer・ABI・allocatorは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlNewDocNode.scope: Detached element/text subtree with optional live document and explicit namespace retention. Shared SPARK content construction with xmlNewChild; predefined/numeric references decoded, malformed/unsupported references rejected rather than silently ignored. NULL/empty decoded input creates no text child. Name copied; dictionary interning/callbacks/general entities and complete public semantics proof excluded.

function:tree.h:xmlNewDocRawNode.scope: Shared SPARK detached element construction with raw text and optional document/namespace ownership. NULL content has no text child; non-NULL empty input has an empty text child. XML validation/escaping deferred to serializer; document-first release safe for retained subtree. Native ABI, dictionary interning/callbacks and full API semantics outside proof claim.

function:tree.h:xmlNewDocProp.scope: Detached unnamespaced attribute created through the shared SPARK document-node path. Optional document must be managed/live and is retained for lifetime; NULL document is allowed. Predefined/numeric references are decoded, invalid/unsupported references are rejected transactionally; NULL/empty value creates no text child. NULL and colon-containing names are rejected. A managed attribute can be attached to an element by xmlAddChild under the same-document/documentless restriction, replacing a matching expanded name only after attachment succeeds. Standalone serialization is unsupported; XML-name completeness, native pointers/ABI, and full C semantics are not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlNewCDataBlock.scope: Bounded raw CDATA construction with optional live document, no attachment and NULL name. Non-NULL negative length rejected; zero length reads no content; NULL/empty distinct. Early NUL ends retained bytes. SPARK construction/owner pin path; document-first release supported. UTF-8/XML validation and CDATA delimiter splitting occur at serialization. Native input validity/callbacks/full API semantics not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlNewDocComment.scope: Document-affiliated comment construction through shared SPARK Store.Content.New_Doc_Content, without tree attachment. NULL doc supported; non-NULL doc must be registered/live. Owner retention protects detached nodes after document release. NULL/empty content distinction and deferred serializer validation match xmlNewComment. Registration callbacks excluded; complete API semantics not formally proved.

function:tree.h:xmlNewDocPI.scope: Document-affiliated PI construction with copied target/content and shared SPARK document-owner retention. NULL doc supported and NULL target rejected. Target/XML syntax validation occurs at serialization, as for xmlNewPI. Native pointer validity, callbacks, dictionary interning and complete public semantics are outside the proof claim.

function:tree.h:xmlNewComment.scope: SPARK Store/Runtimeで独立commentを作成。raw contentをコピーしNULLと空文字列を区別。XML文字・comment構文検査は出力時。NULL contentのcommentは出力なし。登録callbackは未対応。所有権・寿命はSPARK、ABI/native memoryは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlNewPI.scope: SPARK Store/Runtimeで独立PIを作成。NULL targetを拒否、raw target/contentをコピーしNULLと空contentを区別。XML名・文字・予約target・PI構文検査は出力時。登録callbackは未対応。所有権・寿命はSPARK、ABI/native memoryは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlNewText.scope: raw C string content をコピーし UTF-8 検証なし。NULL content は NULL のまま。DOMの所有権・寿命判断はSPARK Store/Runtime、native pointer・ABI・allocatorは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlDocSetRootElement.scope: descendant root promotion を含む文書 root 置換。旧 root subtree の detached ownership を維持。

function:tree.h:xmlAddChild.scope: 限定 node types と same-document/documentless subtree。document parent は text/CDATA 直下と second root を拒否。adjacent text merge。element parent は managed attribute を expanded name (local-name bytes + namespace-href bytes) で照合して追加し、既存一致属性を新属性の Attach 成功後に解放。namespace object が異なっても href 一致で matching、null namespace は区別し、non-null namespace with null href は拒否。最後の属性を再追加すると earlier duplicate があっても no-op。cross-document move は拒否。namespace reconciliation と standalone attribute serialization は未対応。

function:tree.h:xmlAddSibling.scope: SPARK Store resolves an attached reference node's parent and delegates to Add_Child. Appends to the end, coalesces text, and replaces matching expanded-name attributes after attachment. Self-insertion and mixed property/content lists are rejected; an existing tail is a no-op when referenced by a different node. Same document or documentless incoming subtree only. Parentless sibling chains, attribute-value siblings, cross-document moves and namespace reconciliation are unsupported. Native pointer/ABI/allocator and full C semantics remain trusted/unproved.

function:tree.h:xmlAddPrevSibling.scope: Managed content sibling insertion immediately before an attached anchor. Supports element children, document comments/PIs and the single root, plus attribute-value text under existing Attach_Child rules. Rejects NULL/self, attribute sibling operands, document nodes, parentless lists, cycles, extra roots, and cross-document moves unchanged. Preserves node identity, returns the child for adjacency no-ops, performs no normal allocation, and never coalesces adjacent text. Native pointers, facade synchronization, ABI/status mapping, and full public semantics remain trusted/unproved.

function:tree.h:xmlAddNextSibling.scope: Managed content sibling insertion immediately after an attached anchor. Supports element children, document comments/PIs and the single root, plus attribute-value text under existing Attach_Child rules. Rejects NULL/self, attribute sibling operands, document nodes, parentless lists, cycles, extra roots, and cross-document moves unchanged. Preserves node identity, returns the child for adjacency no-ops, performs no normal allocation, and never coalesces adjacent text. Native pointers, facade synchronization, ABI/status mapping, and full public semantics remain trusted/unproved.

function:tree.h:xmlUnlinkNode.scope: 管理中の通常 child と attribute を切り離す。parent/prev/next をクリアし、文書所属・値・namespace・owner pin を保持する。NULL/既に未接続なら no-op。document/namespace/未登録 facade は拒否。SPARK Store/Runtime 経由、native pointer・ABI は信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlFreeNodeList.scope: SPARK Store/Runtime releases the managed sibling suffix and its subtrees, using existing namespace-aware release. Includes document children and attribute-value text; document/attribute/namespace and unmanaged inputs are rejected. Unlike upstream, surviving parent/previous-sibling links are repaired automatically. One final native synchronization; no native allocation. Full public list semantics and native boundaries remain unproved.

function:tree.h:xmlFreeNode.scope: element/text/comment/CDATA/PI subtree のみ unlink して反復解放。document/attribute/namespace pointer は code 115 で拒否。DOMの所有権・寿命判断はSPARK Store/Runtime、native pointer・ABI・allocatorは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlFreeDoc.scope: 現在接続された tree を解放し document 参照を落とす。detached live node/namespace がある parsed arena は参照解放まで保持。全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:tree.h:xmlNodeGetContent.scope: 現在のUTF-8/UTF-16・読み取り専用DOMサブセット内。全オプション・全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:tree.h:xmlNodeListGetRawString.scope: Public API in pinned libxml2 2.15.4. The doc argument is ignored. NULL list returns NULL; a non-NULL managed starting facade walks only its next-sibling chain, concatenating direct text/CDATA content without descent and skipping other kinds. Nonzero inLine copies raw bytes without UTF-8/XML validation; zero validates each selected node's UTF-8 independently, then validates XML characters and escapes special characters after concatenation, rejecting invalid sequences split across node boundaries. A non-NULL list with no selected text returns an independently xmlFree-owned empty string. Entity-reference nodes are unsupported. Foreign facades are rejected before native dereference. Native pointer/readability, allocation/copy/free, ABI, and complete C semantics remain trusted.

function:tree.h:xmlNodeListGetString.scope: Public API in pinned libxml2 2.15.4. Shares the bounded direct text/CDATA next-sibling query; no descent. Nonzero inLine copies raw bytes and ignores doc. Escaped mode accepts NULL or a registered Document_Node and rejects foreign/wrong-kind documents; strict per-node UTF-8 validation and XML character validation after concatenation apply only in this mode. Attribute context comes from the starting node's parent; attribute tabs/LFs are numeric references and quotes use ", text tabs/LFs/quotes remain literal, and non-ASCII is emitted as uppercase hexadecimal character references. Document encoding is not retained, so explicit UTF-8 documents can differ from reference output. Output is an independent xmlFree-owned allocation; NULL list returns NULL while a non-NULL list with no selected text returns an allocated empty string. Allocation failure returns NULL without modifying source topology. HTML-specific behavior/entity expansion is unsupported. Native pointer/readability, byte access, allocation/copy/free, ABI, and complete C semantics remain trusted.

function:tree.h:xmlGetNodePath.scope: 管理中nodeのbounded structural path。無効なUTF-8/XML名は安全のため拒否し、全public C semanticsは未証明。

function:tree.h:xmlGetProp.scope: 現在のUTF-8/UTF-16・読み取り専用DOMサブセット内。全オプション・全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:tree.h:xmlNodeSetName.scope: Managed element, attribute, and processing-instruction renaming with independent name ownership, bounded UTF-8/XML-name validation, atomic conflict rejection, and retained namespace/document lifetime. Unsupported kinds and NULL inputs are harmless no-ops; complete public C semantics and entity-reference support are outside the subset.

function:tree.h:xmlHasProp.scope: 現在のUTF-8/UTF-16・読み取り専用DOMサブセット内。全オプション・全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:tree.h:xmlNewProp.scope: colon のない namespace-free attribute を raw C string から作成。XML name/UTF-8 検証なし。NULL value は child なし、empty value は text child。DOMの所有権・寿命判断はSPARK Store/Runtime、native pointer・ABI・allocatorは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlSetProp.scope: no-namespace property を従来どおり更新し、prefix を含む QName は SPARK で NCName 検証・scope 解決。unbound/malformed prefix は code 115。documentless `xml:lang`/`xml:space` は暗黙 XML namespace を作成する。

function:tree.h:xmlUnsetProp.scope: 同名の namespace-free attribute を削除。欠落・非対応は -1。DOMの所有権・寿命判断はSPARK Store/Runtime、native pointer・ABI・allocatorは信頼境界。

function:tree.h:xmlRemoveProp.scope: attached namespace-free または qualified attribute を安全に unlink/free。detached attribute は拒否。

function:tree.h:xmlFreePropList.scope: SPARK Store/Runtime releases the managed attribute suffix and all value children, retaining namespace declarations and surviving borrowers. Attached lists are safely unlinked; NULL is a no-op; wrong-kind/unmanaged facades are rejected. No native allocation. Full public list semantics and native boundaries remain unproved.

function:tree.h:xmlFreeProp.scope: attribute を解放。attached pointer は先に安全に unlink し、detached pointer も解放。qualified attribute も対応し、namespace declaration は解放しない。

function:tree.h:xmlNodeIsText.scope: Read-only SPARK Store query for managed text nodes only, excluding CDATA. NULL/unregistered facades return 0 without native field traversal. C adapter performs locking and result/error conversion; native ABI is not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlIsBlankNode.scope: Read-only SPARK Store query for empty or XML-whitespace-only managed text/CDATA. Only space, tab, LF and CR qualify. Scans managed content length; no allocation or DOM mutation. NULL/unregistered facades and all other kinds return 0. Native byte access and full public semantics not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlNodeGetLang.scope: Read-only SPARK Store parent walk for managed nodes, matching only the XML namespace URI. Returns a caller-owned copy of the nearest xml:lang, including an empty value that stops inheritance; text, attributes, comments and PI inherit from parents. Document affiliation alone supplies no value. Unmanaged facades return NULL. Native pointers, ABI and full public semantics are not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlNodeGetSpacePreserve.scope: Read-only SPARK Store parent walk from managed elements only, matching the XML namespace URI. Exact preserve/default values return 1/0; empty, unknown or missing values continue to ancestors; no match, invalid node or unmanaged facade returns -1. Temporary copies are freed. Native pointers, ABI and full public semantics are not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlNodeSetLang.scope: SPARK Runtime/Store sets the XML-namespaced lang property on managed elements. NULL sets an empty value rather than removing the attribute. Returns 0 on success, 1 for invalid input and -1 on allocation failure; qualified-property rollback is reused. Native ABI and full public semantics are not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlNodeSetSpacePreserve.scope: SPARK Runtime/Store sets the XML-namespaced space property on managed elements: zero maps to default and every nonzero integer to preserve. Returns 0 on success, 1 for invalid input and -1 on allocation failure; qualified-property rollback is reused. Native ABI and full public semantics are not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlTextConcat.scope: SPARK scalar-only append to managed text, CDATA, comment and PI nodes; content ownership/rollback reuse Store.Content.Replace_Content. Nonnegative length is bounded, zero reads no bytes, negative length consumes a NUL-terminated string. NULL content is a no-op after kind validation; non-NULL empty input materializes empty content. Returns 0 or -1. Stops at first NUL instead of retaining/reading trailing bytes. Native boundary and full public semantics not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlTextMerge.scope: SPARK Store merges distinct managed normal text nodes, allocates combined raw bytes before retiring the second node, and preserves both nodes on native allocation failure. NULL operand returns the other unchanged (including non-text); NULL second content preserves the first content pointer. Same document or documentless second node only; cross-document and no-escape variants unsupported. Shared path with xmlAddChild coalescing; native boundary and full public semantics not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlFirstElementChild.scope: SPARK Store selection of the first direct element child in the supported parsed/edited DOM subset, skipping non-elements. Shared thin C selector; full node-kind/API equivalence is not claimed.

function:tree.h:xmlSearchNs.scope: SPARK Store/Runtime namespace lookup with managed ancestry, shadowing, and retained namespaces. A missing built-in xml binding on documentless nodes is created on the nearest element through Store.Create_Namespace, then reused; failure preserves existing declarations. Implicit declarations append rather than prepend. Prefix lookup skips NULL href declarations. C ABI/native pointer validity and complete lookup semantics are not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlSearchNsByHref.scope: SPARK Store/Runtime URI lookup shares managed shadowing and lazy documentless xml binding creation with xmlSearchNs. NULL URI matches NULL href declarations, distinct from empty href; attribute queries exclude default namespaces. Pure internal searches remain non-mutating for property-update rollback. New implicit declarations append rather than prepend. Full public semantics, native pointer validity, and C ABI remain outside proof.

function:tree.h:xmlGetNsList.scope: SPARK Store/Runtime traverses managed declarations from node through element ancestors, nearest-first and declaration-order, retaining only the nearest declaration for each prefix including default. Includes NULL/empty href declarations; excludes implicit xml bindings and node.namespace-only references; ignores doc. Returns a caller-owned NULL-terminated array with borrowed namespace pointers. Native array representation, pointer validity, and complete public semantics remain outside proof.

function:tree.h:xmlGetNsListSafe.scope: Shares xmlGetNsList traversal. Clears output before lookup; NULL output, NULL/unmanaged/namespace node, and empty results return 1 with NULL; nonempty results return 0; allocation/internal failures return -1 with NULL. Caller frees the array with xmlFree; entries are borrowed. Native C pointer/array ABI and full semantic equivalence are outside proof.

function:tree.h:xmlNodeGetAttrValue.scope: Namespace-aware attribute value lookup through existing SPARK Runtime.Get_Property / Store.Queries.Find_Property / Get_Content. Returns 0 plus an independent xmlFree-compatible copy, 1 plus NULL for missing/invalid node or name (NULL out also returns 1), and -1 plus NULL for allocation, limit, string-conversion, or internal failures. NULL URI means no namespace, not any namespace. C status/output-pointer mapping is shared with existing getters; DTD defaults remain unsupported. Native ABI/output pointer and full public semantics are not proved.

function:tree.h:xmlGetLastChild.scope: SPARK Store/Runtime returns the managed last child without filtering its kind, including a document child or attribute-value text. NULL, empty/scalar nodes, namespaces and unmanaged facades return NULL. Reuses the managed selection path and preserves sticky errors. No native allocation. Native pointer/ABI validity and full C semantics remain unproved.

function:tree.h:xmlLastElementChild.scope: SPARK Store reverse scan from Last_Child for supported element/document parents. Returns the existing last direct element, skipping non-elements; NULL/invalid/unregistered/unsupported-kind input returns NULL. Edited/detached trees supported; fragment/HTML/DTD/entity kinds excluded. Native boundary and full selection semantics outside proof claim.

function:tree.h:xmlPreviousElementSiblin.scope: SPARK Store reverse scan from Previous for supported element/text/CDATA/comment/PI nodes. Skips non-element siblings without allocation; document/attribute/NULL/unregistered inputs return NULL. Edited/detached trees supported; unsupported node kinds and full selection semantics excluded from proof claim.

function:tree.h:xmlNextElementSibling.scope: SPARK Store selection of the next element sibling in the supported parsed/edited DOM subset, skipping non-elements. Shared thin C selector; full node-kind/API equivalence is not claimed.

function:tree.h:xmlChildElementCount.scope: 現在のUTF-8/UTF-16・読み取り専用DOMサブセット内。全オプション・全ノード型の等価性は未確認。

function:tree.h:xmlCopyNamespace.scope: Managed live namespace facades only. Copies href/prefix bytes into an independent detached reservation, preserving NULL versus empty fields; source next/context/_private links are not copied. The caller releases the returned reservation with xmlFreeNs, while node pins retain storage after reservation release. Foreign/stale pointers, namespace-list copying, native pointer validity, C representation/ABI, and complete public semantics remain outside proof.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrdup.scope: Copies a bounded NUL-terminated byte string into a new xmlFree-owned allocation. NULL and unrepresentable/over-limit inputs return NULL; bytes are not UTF-8 validated. C conversion, native pointer validity, allocation, writes, and full API semantics remain outside proof.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrndup.scope: Copies exactly the requested nonnegative bounded byte length, including embedded NUL bytes, and appends a terminator; length zero returns an owned empty string without reading input. NULL/negative/over-limit inputs return NULL. C conversion, native pointer validity, allocation, writes, and full API semantics remain outside proof.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlCharStrdup.scope: C char* wrapper over the bounded NUL-terminated byte duplication path. Copies high-bit bytes unchanged without transcoding or UTF-8 validation; NULL and over-Max_Input inputs return NULL. Result is xmlFree-owned. C conversion, native pointer validity, allocation/writes, ABI, and full semantics remain outside proof.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlCharStrndup.scope: For non-NULL input and nonnegative len, copies at most len C-string bytes and stops at an earlier NUL; len zero returns an owned empty string without reading input. NULL, negative, and over-Max_Input lengths return NULL; an over-limit length is rejected before reading input. Unlike xmlStrndup it does not copy bytes after an embedded NUL. Reference may allocate len+1 with unspecified tail after early NUL; libxml3 allocates only copied-prefix+terminator, so no spare capacity or allocation-size equivalence is promised. Tests compare defined contents only. C conversion, pointer validity, allocation/writes, ABI, and full semantics remain outside proof.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrncatNew.scope: Copies the NUL-terminated left prefix plus the effective right byte span into a new xmlFree-owned, NUL-terminated allocation. Negative length uses the right NUL-terminated length; NULL left delegates to bounded duplication, while NULL right or zero effective length with non-NULL left copies the left. Positive spans preserve embedded NUL and raw bytes. Combined-size limits are checked before reading a positive right span. C conversion, native pointer validity, allocation, writes, and full API semantics remain outside proof.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrcat.scope: NUL-terminated raw-byte append into a fresh xmlFree-owned result. NULL add returns cur unchanged; empty add is unchanged for non-NULL cur but creates an owned empty string for NULL cur. Every other call consumes/frees cur on success and ordinary failure, so cur must be NULL or the base of a caller-owned xmlFree-compatible allocation and must not be reused. The implementation copies before freeing cur, safely supporting add aliases into cur rather than reproducing the reference realloc alias hazard; always-copy may increase peak memory/work. Add is scanned first, then the prefix is bounded by the remaining Max_Bytes cap; a boundary NUL is accepted, but an unresolved scan diagnoses DOM error 115 and returns NULL. OOM uses the existing diagnostic. Errors consume cur. No UTF-8/XML validation or transcoding. Shared ordinary and guard-page cases run against reference and libxml3; alias, cap, and OOM/free-count cases are libxml3-only. SPARK proves bounded length/size arithmetic, native-call preconditions, and status/result contract; native reads/writes/allocation/free, pointer validity, caller ownership, C mapping, and full semantics remain trusted.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrncat.scope: Bounded raw-byte append into a fresh NUL-terminated xmlFree-owned result. NULL add or len=0 returns cur unchanged before negative-length handling. Negative len with non-NULL add returns NULL without a diagnostic and consumes/frees cur; positive len copies exactly len bytes, including embedded NUL, then appends NUL. Cur must be NULL or the base of a caller-owned xmlFree-compatible allocation; it must not be reused after a consuming call. Copy-before-free safely supports add aliases into cur, intentionally avoiding the reference realloc alias hazard at the cost of possible extra peak memory/work. Positive lengths above Max_Bytes are rejected before reading either source; prefix scanning is bounded by Max_Bytes minus the added span, with a boundary NUL accepted. Unresolved scans diagnose DOM error 115; cap/OOM failures return diagnostic NULL and consume cur, with OOM using the existing diagnostic. No UTF-8/XML validation or transcoding. Shared ordinary/raw-span/negative/guard-page cases run against reference and libxml3; alias, cap, and OOM/free-count cases are libxml3-only. SPARK proves bounded length/size arithmetic, native-call preconditions, and status/result contract; native reads/writes/allocation/free, pointer validity, caller ownership, C mapping, and full semantics remain trusted.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrncmp.scope: Compares at most len raw bytes across the full nonnegative C int range without a Max_Input cutoff, returning the unsigned-byte difference and stopping on mismatch, NUL, or bound. Nonpositive length returns 0 before pointer checks; identical pointers return 0; NULL ordering is -1/+1. No allocation or C-string conversion. Bounded loop control and result range are proved, but Native.Byte_At, foreign pointer validity, readable bounds, actual bytes, and full semantics remain trusted.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrncasecmp.scope: Compares at most len raw bytes across the full nonnegative C int range without a Max_Input cutoff, using the pinned byte map (A-Z plus '[' to '{') and stopping on mismatch, NUL, or bound. Nonpositive length returns 0 before pointer checks; identical pointers return 0; NULL ordering is -1/+1. The '[' mapping is a reference quirk, not Unicode case folding. No allocation or C-string conversion; Native.Byte_At, foreign pointer validity, readable bounds, actual bytes, and full semantics remain trusted.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrchr.scope: Finds the first matching non-NUL byte in a NUL-terminated raw byte string and returns a borrowed pointer into the input. NULL input and search value zero return NULL without reading; NUL stops the scan and is not searchable. Scans payload offsets below Max_Bytes, allowing a terminator at offset Max_Bytes; a no-match string without that terminator returns NULL with a diagnostic. Early matches return immediately even for longer strings, so this is a scan cap, not rejection of every longer input. No allocation, mutation, or UTF-8 conversion. SPARK proves loop bounds and status/position contracts; native byte reads, pointer validity, readable bounds, actual contents, address arithmetic, C diagnostics, and full API semantics remain outside proof.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrstr.scope: Finds the first raw-byte substring in a NUL-terminated haystack and returns a borrowed pointer into it. NULL haystack or pattern returns NULL; a non-NULL haystack with an empty pattern returns the original pointer without reading the haystack. Inputs stop at their first NUL, so overlapping aliases, embedded-NUL termination, and UTF-8 fragments are byte behavior with no validation or transcoding. Payload offsets below Max_Bytes and a boundary NUL are scanned; a match ending at the boundary succeeds, while required non-NUL data beyond the cap returns NULL with a diagnostic. Early matches and empty patterns avoid a full scan, so the cap is not blanket rejection of long strings. No allocation or writes. Shared substring vectors, byte-pair comparisons, and guard-page cases run against both libxml3 and the pinned reference; OOM/no-allocation tests are libxml3-only. SPARK proves status/position contracts and loop bounds; native reads, pointer validity/bounds, actual bytes, address arithmetic, C mapping, borrowed lifetime, and full semantics remain outside proof.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrcasestr.scope: Same raw-byte substring search and borrowed-pointer behavior as xmlStrstr, using the pinned byte map for A-Z plus '[' to '{'. This is a reference byte-map quirk, not Unicode case folding. NULL/empty inputs, NUL termination, overlapping aliases, UTF-8 fragments, boundary NUL, Search_Limit_Exceeded diagnostics, and trusted native pointer/read/write boundaries follow xmlStrstr; no allocation, mutation, validation, or transcoding occurs. Shared substring vectors, byte-pair comparisons, and guard-page cases run against both libxml3 and the pinned reference; OOM/no-allocation tests are libxml3-only.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrsub.scope: Returns an independent xmlFree-owned raw-byte slice after validating that offsets 0 through start contain no NUL. NULL input or negative start/len returns NULL without a diagnostic; even len=0 validates start and allocates an empty result only for a valid start. Copies exactly len bytes, including embedded NUL and bytes after it, then appends NUL; this requires the caller to provide a readable span and does not clamp at the source terminator. Before reading, the implementation requires start < Max_Bytes and len <= Max_Bytes - start; limit violations report an error and return NULL. It performs no UTF-8/XML-name validation or transcoding. Shared vectors and guard-page cases run against the pinned reference and libxml3; cap and OOM checks are libxml3-only. SPARK proves status/result, checked bounds, and native-call preconditions; pointer validity, readable memory, actual bytes, allocation freshness/writes, address arithmetic, C mapping, and complete semantics remain trusted.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrQEqual.scope: Compares prefix/name/value as raw bytes. NULL prefix delegates string equality, including NULL/NULL and identical-pointer equality. Non-NULL prefix requires non-NULL name/value and compares literal prefix bytes, a colon, and name bytes through NUL without XML-name or UTF-8 validation; empty names are allowed and additional colons remain raw data. Empty prefix safely returns false without reading name/value, intentionally avoiding the pinned reference's unsafe post-terminator read and NUL-then-':name' tail quirk. Guard-page/tail safety cases are libxml3-only. Early mismatch/identity returns immediately; equality requiring reads beyond the Max_Bytes scan cap returns false (0) with a diagnostic, so long inputs are not blanket-rejected. No allocation or writes. SPARK proves scalar status/null-identity contracts and loop bounds; native reads, foreign pointer validity/bounds, actual bytes, address arithmetic, C error mapping, and full semantics remain outside proof.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrcmp.scope: NUL-terminated unsigned-byte comparison through the first mismatch or NUL. Identical pointers (including NULL/NULL) return 0 without reads; one NULL sorts as -1/+1. Scans offsets 0..Max_Bytes inclusive; a mismatch or NUL at the boundary completes, but equal non-NUL bytes through the cap produce a diagnostic and -1 sentinel that is not a trustworthy ordering result. No allocation, mutation, C-string conversion, UTF-8 validation, or transcoding. Shared byte-pair vectors and guard-page cases run against libxml3 and the pinned reference; OOM/no-allocation checks are libxml3-only. Small-cap behavior is tested via the internal Ada helper with a small Last and formal bounds; no public C string near the cap is dynamically tested. SPARK proves loop bounds, result range, native-call preconditions, and cap-failure contract; foreign pointer validity, readable bounds/actual bytes, address arithmetic, C diagnostics/mapping, and complete API semantics remain trusted.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrcasecmp.scope: Uses the same terminated byte scan, NULL/identity behavior, cap, and diagnostic mapping as xmlStrcmp. Compares bytes after the pinned A-Z map plus the reference quirk '[' to '{'; this is not Unicode case folding. A cap error diagnoses and returns -1, which is not a trustworthy ordering result; early mismatch/NUL/NULL/identity may finish before the cap. No allocation, mutation, C-string conversion, UTF-8 validation, or transcoding. Shared byte-pair vectors and guard-page cases run against libxml3 and the pinned reference; OOM/no-allocation checks are libxml3-only. Small-cap behavior is tested via the internal Ada helper with a small Last and formal bounds; no public C string near the cap is dynamically tested. SPARK proves loop bounds, result range, native-call preconditions, and cap-failure contract; foreign pointer validity, readable bounds/actual bytes, address arithmetic, C diagnostics/mapping, and complete API semantics remain trusted.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrEqual.scope: Returns 1 for raw NUL-terminated byte equality, including identical pointers and NULL/NULL; a single NULL or byte mismatch returns 0. Uses the terminated comparison scan through offsets 0..Max_Bytes inclusive. If equal non-NUL bytes remain through the cap, a diagnostic is recorded and the error sentinel maps to 0; callers should check the diagnostic. Early mismatch/NUL/NULL/identity may finish before the cap. No allocation, mutation, C-string conversion, UTF-8 validation, or transcoding. Shared byte-pair vectors and guard-page cases run against libxml3 and the pinned reference; OOM/no-allocation checks are libxml3-only. Small-cap behavior is tested via the internal Ada helper with a small Last and formal bounds; no public C string near the cap is dynamically tested. SPARK proves loop bounds, result range, native-call preconditions, and cap-failure contract; foreign pointer validity, readable bounds/actual bytes, address arithmetic, C diagnostics/mapping, and complete API semantics remain trusted.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlStrlen.scope: Returns the raw-byte count before the first NUL; NULL returns zero and invalid UTF-8 bytes count as bytes without decoding. The SPARK Read_Length scan checks offsets 0..Max_Bytes inclusive and accepts a NUL at the boundary; unresolved non-NUL data records DOM error 115 and returns -1, an error sentinel callers must not treat as empty. This is a scan cap, not rejection of longer strings that terminate earlier. Unexpected C-side exceptions map to DOM error 1 and -1. Unlike the pinned reference's silent zero above INT_MAX, this subset diagnoses an unresolved scan at Max_Bytes (Integer'Last - 16). Reduced-Last Ada tests exercise cap behavior; no huge public C string is constructed. No allocation, mutation, transcoding, or UTF-8/XML validation. Shared raw-byte, Unicode-byte-count, and guard-page tests run against the reference and libxml3; the no-allocation test is libxml3-only. SPARK proves scan bounds, result/status contracts, and native-call preconditions; actual native reads/bytes, pointer validity/readable bounds, C diagnostic mapping, and complete API semantics remain trusted.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlCheckUTF8.scope: Streams a NUL-terminated byte string with a four-byte stack buffer and validates strict UTF-8 only. NULL, malformed, truncated, overlong, surrogate, and out-of-range encodings return 0; empty input returns 1. NUL stops scanning and bytes after it are not read. ASCII controls and Unicode noncharacters are valid UTF-8 here; this does not check XML character validity. Unlike the pinned reference's permissive acceptance of noncanonical encodings, this subset rejects them deliberately for safety. Invalid input returns 0 without a diagnostic; if no NUL is found through the inclusive Max_Bytes boundary, DOM error 115 is recorded and 0 returned; unexpected exceptions map to error 1 and 0. A boundary NUL is accepted. The scan performs no allocation, mutation, or transcoding. Reduced-Last Ada tests cover cap behavior; no huge public C string is constructed. GNATprove covers loop/index bounds and native-call preconditions, not actual foreign bytes, pointer validity/readable bounds, C mapping, or full Unicode API semantics. Shared normal/malformed and guard-page tests run against the reference and libxml3; reference-permissive vectors expect differing results, and no-allocation/OOM testing is libxml3-only.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlUTF8Strlen.scope: Counts Unicode scalar values before the first NUL in a NUL-terminated UTF-8 string; this is neither byte length nor grapheme-cluster count, and no normalization occurs. Empty input returns 0; NULL, malformed, truncated, overlong, surrogate, out-of-range, or unsupported UTF-8 returns -1 without a diagnostic. ASCII controls and Unicode noncharacters count as valid UTF-8 but are not thereby XML-character validated. The strict scanner deliberately rejects noncanonical encodings permissively counted by the pinned reference, including two consecutive continuation bytes counted as one character. If no NUL is found through the inclusive Max_Bytes boundary, DOM error 115 is recorded and -1 returned; unexpected exceptions map to error 1 and -1. No allocation, input mutation, or transcoding. Reduced-Last Ada tests exercise the cap; no huge public C string is constructed. GNATprove covers counter/loop/index bounds, status/result contracts, and native-call preconditions, not full Unicode API semantics or actual foreign bytes. Pointer validity/readable extent and C diagnostic mapping remain trusted. Shared malformed/reference-permissive and guard-page vectors run against both implementations with differing expected results; OOM/no-allocation checks are libxml3-only.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlUTF8Strsize.scope: Returns the raw byte size of up to the requested number of Unicode scalars, excluding the terminating NUL. NULL input or a nonpositive len returns 0 without reading; if the string is shorter than requested, returns the bytes before NUL. Stops when the requested scalar count is reached and does not inspect following scalars or suffix. A malformed, truncated, overlong, surrogate, out-of-range, or otherwise noncanonical strict UTF-8 prefix returns -1 without a partial size or diagnostic. Reference behavior for invalid UTF-8 is not guaranteed; this implementation explicitly rejects malformed visited prefixes. ASCII controls and Unicode noncharacters are valid UTF-8, not XML-character validation. Unresolved scanning through inclusive Max_Bytes records DOM error 115 and returns -1; unexpected exceptions map to error 1 and -1. No allocation, input mutation, or normalization. Reduced-Last Ada tests cover the cap; no huge public C string is constructed. GNATprove covers scan control, byte-offset bounds, status/result contracts, and native-call preconditions, not full Unicode semantics or actual foreign bytes. Pointer validity/readable extent, actual bytes, and C mapping remain trusted. Shared malformed/reference and guard-page vectors run against both implementations; invalid-reference results are compared only for the tested vectors; OOM/no-allocation checks are libxml3-only.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlUTF8Size.scope: Classifies only the first byte of a UTF-8 sequence. NULL returns -1 without reading; non-NULL input reads exactly byte 0 and never inspects following bytes or requires a NUL terminator. Returns 1 for 0x00..0x7f (including NUL), 2 for 0xc2..0xdf, 3 for 0xe0..0xef, 4 for 0xf0..0xf4, and -1 for all other leading bytes. A lone 0xe2 returns 3; 0xed followed by surrogate bytes also returns 3 because continuation, truncation, scalar validity, and XML character validity are not checked. A single readable non-terminated byte is sufficient. Normal results allocate nothing, do not mutate input, and record no diagnostic; unexpected exceptions map to DOM error 1 and -1. The pinned reference also reads only the lead byte but reports widths for invalid leaders 0xc0..0xc1, 0xf5..0xf7, 0xf8..0xfb, 0xfc..0xfd, and 0xfe; this implementation intentionally rejects them. Use xmlCheckUTF8 or xmlGetUTF8Char for validation or decoding. SPARK covers lead classification and result contracts, not actual foreign bytes, readable extent/pointer validity, C mapping/ABI, or complete Unicode/API semantics. The guard-page loop tests all 256 values as the final readable byte before PROT_NONE; standalone non-terminated one-byte inputs and no-allocation behavior are also tested.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlUTF8Charcmp.scope: Compares only the first character-width span, using the first differing unsigned-byte value rather than Unicode code-point subtraction. Two NULL pointers return 0; only-NULL-left returns -1 and only-NULL-right returns 1 without reading the non-NULL pointer. With both non-NULL, the left lead is classified first; an invalid lead returns Invalid/-1 before reading right. Width is 1..4 (NUL is width 1). A bounded comparison stops at its first byte difference, NUL, or width; nonzero differences return immediately without decoding or validating either complete sequence (for example E2 x vs E3 y is -1 and 'a' vs 0xff is -158, both without diagnostics). Only equal bytes trigger strict validation of the left first scalar with Get_UTF8_Char before returning 0, including same-pointer comparisons; equal malformed, truncated, overlong, surrogate, or out-of-range prefixes return Invalid/-1, intentionally differing from the pinned reference's 0. Valid first characters retain the reference byte difference; suffixes are ignored. No case folding, normalization, grapheme matching, or XML-character validation occurs; controls and noncharacters are valid UTF-8. The C adapter maps Invalid to DOM error 9 (XML_FROM_TREE/XML_ERR_INVALID_CHAR) and converts the result. Diagnostic-allocation failure may instead report standard OOM error 2; unexpected exceptions map to error 1 and -1. Comparisons normally allocate nothing and do not mutate either input, but diagnostics may allocate; successful comparisons do not clear prior last error, so callers should reset/check it to distinguish a diagnosed -1 from a legitimate result. No scan cap exceeds the left character's width (at most four bytes). Caller memory must stay readable/stable through accessed bytes; equality may read the full first scalar or NUL even for aliases. SPARK proves the -255..255 result range, Invalid=>-1 contract, and native-call preconditions, not actual native bytes, pointer validity/readable extent/stability, C mapping/ABI, or full Unicode/API equivalence.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlUTF8Strloc.scope: Returns the zero-based Unicode-scalar index of the first occurrence of the pattern's first scalar, not a byte offset. Pattern bytes after that first scalar and source bytes after a match are ignored. The first pattern scalar and each visited source scalar through the match are strictly UTF-8 validated; malformed, truncated, overlong, surrogate, out-of-range, or otherwise noncanonical visited prefixes return -1 without a diagnostic or partial index. NULL on either pointer returns -1 without reading the other pointer, and an invalid first pattern scalar is rejected before source access. The preserved empty-pattern quirk returns 0 for any nonempty source after reading byte zero only, without validating it; an empty source returns -1. ASCII controls and Unicode noncharacters are valid UTF-8, not XML-character validation; no case folding, normalization, or grapheme matching occurs. Normal outcomes allocate nothing and mutate no input. Inclusive Max_Bytes exhaustion maps to DOM error 115 and -1; unexpected exceptions map to error 1 and -1. Inputs must remain readable and stable through the first pattern scalar and the matched source scalar or NUL; a match scalar may end at a guard page without a terminator. The C adapter maps status, index, and diagnostics only. GNATprove covers scan control, scalar-index bounds, status/result contracts, and native-call preconditions, not native bytes, readable extent, pointer validity/stability, C ABI/mapping, or complete UTF-8/API semantics. Tests cover scalar indexing, first-scalar-only matching, malformed-reference differences, the empty-pattern exception, DOM lifetime, exact-span guard cases, and no allocation.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlUTF8Strndup.scope: Creates an independent NUL-terminated owned copy of up to the requested number of Unicode scalars. NULL input or a negative len returns NULL without reading, allocating, or recording a diagnostic; a non-NULL zero len allocates a new empty string without reading input. Positive len validates only the traversed strict UTF-8 prefix, stopping at the requested scalar count or the first NUL; an unvisited suffix is not inspected. A malformed, truncated, overlong, surrogate, out-of-range, or otherwise noncanonical visited prefix returns NULL before allocation with no partial copy or diagnostic. The strict rejection is an intentional safety difference from unspecified/permissive invalid-reference behavior. ASCII controls and Unicode noncharacters are valid UTF-8, not XML-character validation. Cap exhaustion through inclusive Max_Bytes records DOM error 115 and returns NULL; allocation failure maps to the standard memory error 2 and NULL; unexpected exceptions map to error 1 and NULL. The returned buffer is caller-owned and must be freed with xmlFree; input is not mutated or freed. Reduced-Last Ada tests cover the cap; no huge public C string is constructed. GNATprove covers scan/span control, bounds, status/result contracts, and native-call preconditions, not native bytes, readable/stable extents, pointer validity, allocator behavior, C ABI/mapping, or complete Unicode API semantics. Shared malformed/reference and guard-page vectors run against both implementations; OOM/no-allocation checks are libxml3-only.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlUTF8Strsub.scope: Returns an independent NUL-terminated owned copy of up to len Unicode scalars starting at scalar position start. NULL input, negative start/count, and starts beyond the scalar length return NULL; NULL and negative arguments do so without reading, allocating, or recording a diagnostic. Start zero/count zero performs no input reads and allocates an empty copy. The skipped prefix is strictly UTF-8 validated before the selected prefix is validated and copied. Count zero still validates skipped scalars without reading the target; starting at the scalar length returns an empty owned copy even for positive count. Malformed, truncated, overlong, surrogate, out-of-range, or otherwise noncanonical visited bytes return NULL before allocation without partial output or diagnostic, while the unvisited suffix is untouched. The pinned reference may skip non-NUL continuation values without validating them; strict rejection is an intentional safety divergence. A single inclusive Max_Bytes cap covers skipped and selected spans and is not reset at start; cap exhaustion records DOM error 115 and returns NULL. Allocation failure maps to standard memory error 2, unexpected exceptions to error 1, both with NULL. Counts Unicode scalars, not bytes or grapheme clusters; no normalization, transcoding, input mutation, or input free occurs. Controls and Unicode noncharacters are valid UTF-8, not XML-character validation. Caller owns the returned copy and must release it with xmlFree. Reduced-Last Ada tests cover the global cap; no huge public C string is constructed. GNATprove covers scan/span control, bounds, status/result contracts, and native-call preconditions, not native bytes, readable/stable extents, pointer/offset arithmetic, allocation behavior, C ABI/mapping, or complete Unicode API semantics. Shared malformed/reference and guard-page vectors run against both implementations; OOM/no-allocation tests are libxml3-only.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlUTF8Strpos.scope: Returns a borrowed pointer to the zero-based Unicode scalar position. NULL input or a negative position returns NULL without a diagnostic; position zero returns the input pointer without reading. Only the prefix before the target position is strictly UTF-8 validated; the target scalar and suffix are neither read nor validated. At the exact scalar length it returns the NUL address without reading that byte; positions past the end return NULL after observing NUL. ASCII controls and Unicode noncharacters are valid UTF-8, not XML-character validation. The scanner deliberately rejects overlongs, surrogates, out-of-range scalars, and five-byte sequences accepted by the pinned reference. An unresolved prefix through inclusive Max_Bytes records DOM error 115 and returns NULL; unexpected exceptions map to error 1 and NULL. No allocation, input mutation, or normalization; the result is borrowed and must not be freed. Reduced-Last Ada tests cover the cap; no huge public C string is constructed. GNATprove covers scan control, counter/offset bounds, status/result contracts, and native-call preconditions, not full Unicode semantics or actual foreign bytes. Pointer validity/readable extent and C mapping remain trusted. Shared reference-permissive and guard-page vectors run against both implementations with differing expectations; OOM/no-allocation checks are libxml3-only.

function:xmlstring.h:xmlGetUTF8Char.scope: Decodes one strict UTF-8 scalar from at most *len readable bytes and returns its code point, updating *len to consumed width. NULL utf, NULL len, or *len < 1 returns -1; when len is non-NULL it is set to 0 for failure, and *len < 1 is handled without reading utf. NUL decodes as code point 0 with width 1; ASCII controls and Unicode noncharacters are accepted as UTF-8. Invalid, truncated, overlong, surrogate, out-of-range, or unsupported lead bytes return -1 with *len = 0 and no diagnostic; unexpected C-side exceptions map to DOM error 1, *len = 0, and -1. Unlike the pinned reference, the decoder rejects F8..FF lead-byte masking (including F8 90 80 80 and FC 80 80 80) and avoids the reference's utf[0] read before checking *len < 1. No allocation, input mutation, transcoding, or XML validation occurs. GNATprove covers scalar loop/index/overflow safety, width bounds, and native-call preconditions, not complete Unicode API semantics or actual foreign bytes. Pointer validity, *len-byte readable extent, and C mapping remain trusted. Shared vectors, reference-permissive vectors with differing expectations, and exact-span guard-page tests run against both reference and libxml3; the zero-length unreadable-pointer safety test and OOM/no-allocation checks are libxml3-only.

macro:xmlmemory.h:xmlFree.scope: 通常の解放呼び出しのみ。上流のallocator変数/マクロ差し替えは非互換。

variable:xmlmemory.h:xmlFree.scope: 通常の解放呼び出しのみ。上流のallocator変数/マクロ差し替えは非互換。

function:xmlerror.h:xmlGetLastError.scope: per-OS-thread last-error retrieval; supported numeric diagnostics and exact message text remain a documented subset.

function:xmlerror.h:xmlResetLastError.scope: Explicitly clears the calling thread's last error and owned strings.

function:xmlerror.h:xmlResetError.scope: Resets caller-owned xmlError records; foreign pointers remain caller responsibility.

function:xmlerror.h:xmlCopyError.scope: Deep-copies owned strings transactionally for valid zero-initialized or previously reset destinations.

function:tree.h:xmlNewNs.scope: href/prefix をコピーして standalone または element 宣言を作成。NULL と empty prefix/href を区別し、同じ要素の local prefix 重複を拒否。constructed namespace は明示 reservation を持つ。

function:tree.h:xmlSetNs.scope: element/attribute の namespace reference のみを変更し、NULL で解除。unknown facade は Store identity lookup で拒否し、node content/document pin を保持。

function:tree.h:xmlFreeNs.scope: attached または parsed/unowned namespace の手動解放を拒否。detached constructed namespace の explicit reservation を一度解放し、borrower pin が残る間は保持。NULL は no-op。

function:tree.h:xmlNewNsProp.scope: namespace-aware detached/attached attribute を作成。local name と値をコピーし、NULL value と empty value を区別。expanded name が異なる重複 local name を許す。

function:tree.h:xmlSetNsProp.scope: URI と local name で既存属性を照合。既存 attribute address、`_private`、list position を保持し、新値確保後に namespace/value を更新。

function:tree.h:xmlValidateName.scope: SPARK Text.Valid_Name/Name_Width checks XML 1.0 fifth-edition Name characters, including colon and UTF-8. Optional leading/trailing XML whitespace for any nonzero space. Returns 0 valid, 1 invalid, -1 NULL/conversion limit/internal exception. Leaves last error unchanged. C pointer/ABI and complete lexical equivalence are outside proof.

function:tree.h:xmlSplitQName2.scope: Raw-byte first-colon split, not lexical validation or namespace resolution. Returns independently allocated NUL-terminated prefix/local copies owned by xmlFree; clears prefix output first and returns NULL for NULL inputs/outputs, no colon, or leading/trailing first colon. Later colons, spaces and malformed UTF-8 remain raw bytes. QName2 allocation failure cleans partial output and reports the existing memory diagnostic. C conversion limits, native allocator/copy/pointer ABI and complete public semantics remain outside proof. OOM injection is libxml3-only; the pinned-reference Unicode comparison does not run it.

function:tree.h:xmlSplitQName3.scope: Raw-byte first-colon split, not validation. Returns a borrowed pointer into the input local suffix and writes the prefix byte length only on success; leaves length unchanged on failure. No native allocation or DOM mutation. Later colons, spaces and malformed UTF-8 remain raw bytes. C conversion limits, pointer arithmetic/ABI and complete public semantics remain outside proof. OOM injection is libxml3-only; the pinned-reference Unicode comparison does not run it.

function:tree.h:xmlBuildQName.scope: Raw-byte builder, not lexical validation. NULL prefix returns the borrowed original name; non-NULL empty prefix builds ':name'. Uses a caller buffer only when capacity is sufficient; otherwise leaves it untouched and returns an xmlFree-owned allocation. NULL name and negative capacity return NULL. Combined size is bounded; C conversion, native allocation/write, pointer ABI, and complete semantics remain outside proof. Overlap safety is libxml3-only and excluded from reference comparison.

function:tree.h:xmlValidateNCName.scope: Shared pure SPARK name validator in NCName mode rejects colon and enforces a NameStartChar. Optional XML whitespace, status mapping and trust boundary as xmlValidateName.

function:tree.h:xmlValidateQName.scope: Shared pure SPARK validator accepts an NCName or two nonempty NCNames separated by one colon; it does not resolve bindings. XML whitespace, status mapping and trust boundary as xmlValidateName.

function:tree.h:xmlValidateNMToken.scope: Shared pure SPARK validator accepts nonempty NameChar sequences including colon, digits and combining characters at the start. XML whitespace, status mapping and trust boundary as xmlValidateName.

function:tree.h:xmlUnsetNsProp.scope: namespace URI と local name で属性を照合して削除。欠落時は -1。
